title: Lagrange Barycentric Vandermonde Qudit Witness Annihilation Over F_p
claims: For any d + 2 distinct evaluation points x_0, ..., x_{d+1} in F_p, the barycentric weights w_j = prod_{l != j} (x_j - x_l)^{-1} mod p satisfy sum_j w_j x_j^r == 0 (mod p) for 0 <= r <= d and sum_j w_j x_j^{d+1} == 1 (mod p).
Applying the Z_p-weighted modular qudit sum with weights w_j annihilates 100% of p^{d+1} polynomials of degree <= d while extracting the exact leading degree-(d+1) coefficient.
